coordinates: Source pixels: origin upper-left; x right, y down; bounding boxes xyxy, right/bottom exclusive.

measurement_method.silhouette: Reject pixels where G>R+24, G>B+24 and G>170; keep largest connected component; fill interior holes. No temporal rescaling.
measurement_method.silhouette_uncertainty_px: Usually 1-3 pixels at antialiased edges; larger under motion blur (especially f406-f414).
measurement_method.landmarks: Human-chosen semantic ROIs, largest connected dark component inside each ROI using R<145,G<135,B<130. Centroids describe visible color patches, NOT 3D joints.
measurement_method.boundary_labels: Human review of contact sheets at 0.1s intervals; exact frame numbers encode timing samples, with transition uncertainty recorded separately.

display_mapping.formula: x_target = uniform_scale*x_source + tx; y_target = uniform_scale*y_source + ty
display_mapping.use: Fixed image-plane comparison transform for every frame; never independently normalize each frame because that would erase the jump and fall.
display_mapping.warning: This is a 2D crop/zoom mapping, not an inferred 3D camera calibration.

events.label: Initial blink
events.evidence: Dark area in fixed near-eye ROI drops from roughly 500 pixels to 21-72 pixels.

events.label: Mouth opens into first laugh
events.evidence: Dark head-ROI area grows from ~1000 at f63 to 5764 at f69.

events.label: Hands lift from belly to head
Hands return from head to belly
Pre-jump crouch minimum
events.evidence: Foreground top reaches y362 at f396 versus y172 at f387; feet remain near y1023.

events.label: Apparent takeoff
events.evidence: Lowest silhouette point moves from standing y1023 to y978 by f405. Background has no visible ground, so contact timing is inferred from the stable standing baseline.

events.label: Largest lowest-point separation from baseline
events.evidence: Bottom of silhouette y880, or 143 pixels above the standing baseline. This is NOT the center-of-mass trajectory, because rotation changes the silhouette.

events.label: Supine pose established
events.evidence: Bounding box becomes wide and low, head at image right; by f417 bbox=[654,660,1236,990].

phases.observation: Stand with both palms on abdomen; brief eye closure around f21-30.
Transition into laughter: face turns toward camera, mouth opens and torso/head rise.
Head tilted back; open-mouth laugh; hands remain on abdomen with small independent bounces.
First forward body fold; head moves down and left in image; hands move down abdomen.
Recover toward upright and continue laughing with repeated smaller body movements.
Hands leave abdomen, arms lift toward head; torso folds forward briefly.
Both hands at the sides/top of head, elbows spread; continued laughing.
Hands release head and descend toward abdomen.
Hands overlap lower abdomen; upright laughter.
Second forward fold with palms still together on lower abdomen.
Head/body tilt back again, mouth open; palms stay together on abdomen.
Brief recovery with eyes opening and mouth substantially narrowing.
Crouch/preparation: head and torso drop, both hands low on abdomen.
Rise and visible foot separation from standing baseline; hands extend forward; body turns side-on.
Airborne backward rotation; feet and arms separate; body approaches horizontal.
Rapid drop and transition to a supine pose; arms return toward abdomen.
Supine laugh with head at image right, both hands on abdomen and alternating leg lifts.

missing.mouth: Motion blur and grazing view prevent a reliable dark-mouth landmark.

limitations: Single-view video does not uniquely determine bone angles, camera focal length, depth, unseen surfaces, or original rig.
The reference has stylized/nonrigid shape variation; fit the supplied milkfrog.blend without claiming recovered original production animation.
Hand and foot color-region centroids can shift with occlusion/shading; they must not be used as exact wrist/ankle joints.
Frame 411 is strongly motion-blurred; exclude its mouth from facial landmark fitting.
asset_basis: User-provided milkfrog.blend; this file contains observations for pose/animation fitting, not a replacement model.
